purpose: Test three research-backed improvement lanes against the exact strongest confirmed five-player champion without privileged online information

post_diagnostic_followup.reason: The original learned sampler improved contrastive world recognition but worsened finite-proposal marginal calibration. This follow-up was specified after that diagnostic, before any protected games.
post_diagnostic_followup.experiment: Same frozen learned energy with symmetric Metropolis swaps of hidden physical card slots, 128 burn-in transitions and 16 thinning transitions, retaining 75 percent fresh uniform mixture
post_diagnostic_followup.selection_data: Original calibration partition only; no new model selection using the original final predictive test

selection: Rank development finalists by deal-block pairwise placement against the exact baseline. Prefer a positive paired score advantage and no increase in matched actor-owned paradox count. Locked scenarios and information-safety checks are mandatory. Development results are exploratory, not promotion evidence.

confirmation.primary_endpoint: mean paired deal-block difference in official pairwise placement, compared with exact champion on the same deals and seats
confirmation.primary_pass: corrected confidence interval lower bound strictly greater than zero
additional_guards: candidate-owned paradox count no greater than matched baseline-owned count
baseline and candidate code/model provenance unchanged
confirmation.stop_rule: Stop at first planned look satisfying all gates, or report failure/inconclusive at256 independent deals. Do not keep sampling until a favorable p-value appears.

match_design: Complete five-round matches with cyclic seat rotations within each independent common deal; four exact baseline opponents. Run matched baseline actor on identical deals. Treat deals, not individual seats/rounds, as the independent statistical unit.
scope: Five-player experimental result only; no claims about other player counts, human strength, mobile parity, or deployment. No source/app/champion replacement without verified improvement.

compute.confirmation_orchestration: An isolated arena snapshot raises only the worker ceiling from4to12; original development arena and all inference code remain unchanged. Full-map pre/post receipts are mandatory for every protected baseline/candidate block.
compute.development_throughput_retry: Once other lanes completed, the unfinished16-deal search extension may be restarted once on12workers with the exact same frozen selector, seed and deal IDs, in a new output directory. Preserve and mark the incomplete attempt unscored; never rerun a completed result. This changes throughput only and consumes no protected data.

information_contract: Every real and simulated actor uses only own remembered cards/discard and public history. Constrained imagined hands are allowed; actual opponents' hidden cards, discards, future deal state, or deal seeds are not online inputs. Fail closed on sampler inconsistency. Hidden labels, if used in belief training, are targets only.
